ordinance_area_text: It shall be unlawful to shoot or discharge any firearm, compound bow, cross-bow, air-operated weapon or gas-operated weapon in the following high density areas of the county, except for the protection of one's life or property: (1) R-2 Limited Residential. (2) Gwynnfield Subdivision. (3) Maryfield Subdivision. (4) Daingerfield Subdivision. (5) Shellfield Beach. (6) Richmond Beach. (7) Riverdale. (8) Tuscorora. (9) South Hill Banks. (10) River Oaks. (11) Fort Lowery Beach. (12) Grandview Subdivision. (13) Millers Square. (14) Wilson Acres. (15) Rappahannock Beach. (16) Kaighn Subdivision. (17) Old Howetons Road Subdivision.
method: Downloaded all 10,255 Essex County tax parcels (county ArcGIS Online layer, LegalDescr + TaxMap fields). Matched each name against the assessor legal description (excluding "ADJ ..." = adjacent-to parcels), then used the tax-map page/block that the matches fall on (Essex tax-map pages are drawn per subdivision, e.g. 26C = Gwynnfield) to take every parcel on that page/block. Unioned parcels, morphological closing of 25 m to absorb internal roads, filled holes < 2 ha (not clipped to the coarse county outline, since waterfront lots extend past it), simplified 0.0001 deg, rounded to 5 decimals. R-2 zoning item (1) is out of scope here.
notes: Parcel-derived approximations of subdivision extents (no official subdivision boundary layer exists). Per-name caveats: Richmond Beach: Only 2 parcels carry the RICHMOND BEACH legal description (lots 14-16, tax map 37C block 1). Polygon = all 9 parcels of tax map 37C block 1 (Richmond Beach Rd / Granary Rd). Lies 100% inside the Census place boundary of the Town of Tappahannock; whether the county ordinance applies inside the town was not verified. Low confidence on extent. | Riverdale: Two assessor groups use the RIVERDALE legal description: the main subdivision (tax map 37A blocks 1-3, sections A-C, ~70 lots, Rappahannock River south of Tappahannock) and a small 8-lot group on Summer Breeze Ln (tax map 47B block 1, near Tuscarora). Both are included; the 47B group is uncertain. | Tuscorora: Ordinance says "Tuscorora"; mapped as Tuscorora/Tuscarora Beach (incl. Tuscarora Beach II and the C B Allen plat parcels on tax map 47A). Nearby "Tuscarora Bray 1809" family divisions / Tuscarora Creek Estates / Tuscarora Pines were NOT included. | Shellfield Beach: Includes Upper Shellfield Beach (tax map 38 block 4) as well as Shellfield Beach (38D block 1); excludes Shellfield Landing (separate subdivision). | Old Howetons Road Subdivision: Ordinance spelling "Old Howetons Road"; matched to assessor legal description OLD HOWERTON ROAD lots 1-9 (tax map 44 block 7). | Fort Lowery Beach: Assessor spells FORT/FT LOWERY or LOWRY BEACH; tax map 38C blocks 1-2 (also contains Point Lowery Beach lots 1&2). | Daingerfield Subdivision: Tax map 31D block 1; excludes unrelated Wakefield lots on Daingerfield St (Tappahannock). | Kaighn Subdivision: Tax map 53A block 1 (Cottage Row); neighbouring Neale lots (53A block 2) excluded. | Millers Square: Tax map 49C block 1 (also contains 2 Perry's Place lots). | Gwynnfield Subdivision: Tax map 26C blocks 1-12 plus GWYNNFIELD (PART) boat landing & marsh parcel on map 26. Large lots; polygon spans ~375 ha. Parcel geometries are flagged by the county as being mid-update. Highest uncertainty: Richmond Beach, Riverdale (second group), Tuscorora.
